title: Pullwise Reviewer contract v1
description: Closed public, worker, and admin document contract. Registry arrays are generated from registry.json and must remain byte-for-byte equal.

x-invariants: end_byte > start_byte
the byte range is evaluated against the exact immutable file content_digest
reason_code is null iff state is REVIEWED
path is unique within a result candidate
rejection_code is null iff feasible is true
coverage_reviewed <= coverage_total
terminal_outcome is non-null iff state is COMPLETED, PARTIAL, FAILED, or CANCELLED
terminal_outcome equals state for terminal states
issue_id values are unique
all items derive to the authenticated tenant before any write
the batch is all-or-nothing
